<!--
Title: type(scope): summary   (types: feat, fix, chore, refactor, test, docs)
Write for a reviewer deciding whether to merge: plain sentences, no
shorthand, no undefined abbreviations. The reader did not watch the
session that produced this change.
For a bug fix, you may replace "## Summary" with "## Problem" + "## Fix".
Delete these comments before submitting.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What changed and why. -->
-

## Risk

<!-- Required. What could break, what is hard to reverse, what you are
unsure of — schema or RLS changes, data migrations, shared exercise
library semantics. Note anything that should be recorded in
KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Do not bury this in Summary bullets. If none, write
"No significant risk" and say in one line why. -->
-

## Verification

<!-- [x] with results, e.g. `npx tsc --noEmit — clean`, `npm run lint —
clean`, plus the manual flow exercised. Use [ ] for steps still to do. -->
- [ ]

## Decision needed

<!-- Optional — include only when the reviewer must decide something
beyond "merge": an open question, a trade-off that could have gone
another way, or scope deliberately left out. Otherwise delete. -->
